# Twitch, YouTube and Kick accounts and moderation

C# methods for a **Run C# code** step. See [C# methods](index.md) for how to use them.

## SendWhisper

Sends a private Twitch whisper to someone. Your bot account sends it when one is signed in, otherwise your broadcaster account. Set bot to false to always use the broadcaster.

```csharp
bool SendWhisper(string userName, string message, bool bot = true)
```

**Gives back:** true when Twitch took the whisper (Twitch may still drop it quietly), false when the name or message is empty or it failed.

**Example**

```csharp
bool sent = CPH.SendWhisper("CoolViewer", "Thanks for the raid!");
CPH.LogInfo($"Whisper sent: {sent}");
```

## TwitchAnnounce

Posts a highlighted announcement in your Twitch chat. Colours: default, blue, green, orange or purple. Your broadcaster account always sends it; bot and fallback are ignored.

```csharp
void TwitchAnnounce(string message, bool bot = false, string? color = null, bool fallback = false)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.TwitchAnnounce("Giveaway starts in 5 minutes!", false, "purple");
```

## TwitchGetBroadcaster

Gets your own Twitch account (the broadcaster account you signed in with): its id, login and display name.

```csharp
TwitchUserInfo? TwitchGetBroadcaster()
```

**Gives back:** Your account details, or null (nothing) when Twitch is not signed in.

**Example**

```csharp
var me = CPH.TwitchGetBroadcaster();
if (me != null) CPH.LogInfo($"Signed in as {me.UserName}");
```

## TwitchGetBot

Gets your Twitch bot account: its id, login and display name.

```csharp
TwitchUserInfo? TwitchGetBot()
```

**Gives back:** The bot account details, or null (nothing) when no bot account is signed in.

**Example**

```csharp
var bot = CPH.TwitchGetBot();
if (bot != null) CPH.LogInfo($"Bot is {bot.UserName}");
```

## TwitchGetUserInfoByLogin

Looks up a Twitch user by their login name (an @ in front is fine). Also says whether Cuebot has seen them as a sub, mod or VIP in chat.

```csharp
TwitchUserInfo? TwitchGetUserInfoByLogin(string userLogin)
```

**Gives back:** The user's details, or null (nothing) when there is no such user or Twitch did not answer.

**Example**

```csharp
var user = CPH.TwitchGetUserInfoByLogin("CoolViewer");
if (user != null) CPH.LogInfo($"{user.UserName} has id {user.UserId}");
```

## TwitchGetUserInfoById

Looks up a Twitch user by their user id (a number given as text). Also says whether Cuebot has seen them as a sub, mod or VIP in chat.

```csharp
TwitchUserInfo? TwitchGetUserInfoById(string userId)
```

**Gives back:** The user's details, or null (nothing) when there is no such user or Twitch did not answer.

**Example**

```csharp
var user = CPH.TwitchGetUserInfoById("123456789");
if (user != null) CPH.LogInfo($"Found {user.UserName}");
```

## TwitchGetExtendedUserInfoByLogin

Looks up lots about a Twitch user by login: bio, profile picture, game, stream title, account age, and whether they follow or subscribe (when Cuebot has permission to see that).

```csharp
TwitchUserInfoEx? TwitchGetExtendedUserInfoByLogin(string userLogin)
```

**Gives back:** The user's details, or null (nothing) when there is no such user or Twitch did not answer.

**Example**

```csharp
var user = CPH.TwitchGetExtendedUserInfoByLogin("CoolViewer");
if (user != null) CPH.LogInfo($"{user.UserName} last played {user.Game}");
```

## TwitchGetExtendedUserInfoById

Looks up lots about a Twitch user by user id: bio, profile picture, game, stream title, account age, and whether they follow or subscribe (when Cuebot may see that).

```csharp
TwitchUserInfoEx? TwitchGetExtendedUserInfoById(string userId)
```

**Gives back:** The user's details, or null (nothing) when there is no such user or Twitch did not answer.

**Example**

```csharp
var user = CPH.TwitchGetExtendedUserInfoById("123456789");
if (user != null) CPH.LogInfo($"Follows you: {user.IsFollowing}");
```

## TwitchTimeoutUser

Times a Twitch user out of chat for a number of seconds, with an optional reason. Your broadcaster account does it; useBot is ignored.

```csharp
bool TwitchTimeoutUser(string userName, int duration, string? reason = null, bool useBot = false)
```

**Gives back:** true when it worked, false when Twitch refused or the name is empty (a warning goes in the log).

**Example**

```csharp
bool done = CPH.TwitchTimeoutUser("SpamBot123", 600, "Spamming links");
CPH.LogInfo($"Timed out: {done}");
```

## TwitchBanUser

Bans a Twitch user from your chat, with an optional reason. Your broadcaster account does it; useBot is ignored.

```csharp
bool TwitchBanUser(string userName, string? reason = null, bool useBot = false)
```

**Gives back:** true when it worked, false when Twitch refused or the name is empty (a warning goes in the log).

**Example**

```csharp
bool done = CPH.TwitchBanUser("SpamBot123", "Bot account");
CPH.LogInfo($"Banned: {done}");
```

## TwitchUnbanUser

Lets a banned or timed-out Twitch user chat again. Your broadcaster account does it; useBot is ignored.

```csharp
bool TwitchUnbanUser(string userName, bool useBot = false)
```

**Gives back:** true when it worked, false when Twitch refused or the name is empty.

**Example**

```csharp
bool done = CPH.TwitchUnbanUser("CoolViewer");
CPH.LogInfo($"Unbanned: {done}");
```

## TwitchRunCommercial

Runs an ad break on your Twitch channel. The length is in seconds, from 30 to 180; other numbers are moved into that range.

```csharp
bool TwitchRunCommercial(int length)
```

**Gives back:** true when the ad started, false when Twitch refused.

**Example**

```csharp
bool started = CPH.TwitchRunCommercial(90);
CPH.LogInfo($"Ad started: {started}");
```

## CreateStreamMarker

Puts a marker at this moment of your Twitch stream, with a short note, so you can find it later when making highlights. Only works while you are live.

```csharp
StreamMarker? CreateStreamMarker(string description)
```

**Gives back:** The marker (its id, note and how many seconds into the stream it is), or null (nothing) when Twitch refused.

**Example**

```csharp
var marker = CPH.CreateStreamMarker("Epic boss fight");
if (marker != null) CPH.LogInfo($"Marker at {marker.Position} seconds");
```

## CreateClip

Makes a Twitch clip of your live stream. Twitch picks the clip's length and title; a title you give is only copied into the result, and the duration is ignored.

```csharp
ClipData? CreateClip()
ClipData? CreateClip(string? title, int duration)
```

**Gives back:** The clip (with its link and edit link), or null (nothing) when Twitch refused, for example while you are offline.

**Example**

```csharp
var clip = CPH.CreateClip();
if (clip != null) CPH.SendMessage($"Clip: {clip.Url}");
```

## SetChannelTitle

Changes the title of your Twitch stream.

```csharp
bool SetChannelTitle(string title)
```

**Gives back:** true when it worked, false when the title is empty or Twitch refused.

**Example**

```csharp
bool done = CPH.SetChannelTitle("Speedrun practice! !discord");
CPH.LogInfo($"Title changed: {done}");
```

## SetChannelGame

Changes the category (game) of your Twitch stream, found by its name, like "Just Chatting".

```csharp
GameInfo? SetChannelGame(string game)
```

**Gives back:** The category it picked (its name and id), or null (nothing) when the name is empty or no category matches.

**Example**

```csharp
var game = CPH.SetChannelGame("Minecraft");
if (game != null) CPH.LogInfo($"Category is now {game.Name}");
```

## YouTubeGetLatestMonitoredBroadcast

Gets the newest YouTube broadcast (live stream) Cuebot is watching: its title, link, status and chat id.

```csharp
YouTubeBroadcastInfo? YouTubeGetLatestMonitoredBroadcast()
```

**Gives back:** The broadcast, or null (nothing) when Cuebot is not watching any.

**Example**

```csharp
var stream = CPH.YouTubeGetLatestMonitoredBroadcast();
if (stream != null) CPH.LogInfo($"Live on YouTube: {stream.Title}");
```

## YouTubeGetLatestBroadcast

Gets the newest YouTube broadcast Cuebot is watching. Works the same as YouTubeGetLatestMonitoredBroadcast.

```csharp
YouTubeBroadcastInfo? YouTubeGetLatestBroadcast()
```

**Gives back:** The broadcast, or null (nothing) when Cuebot is not watching any.

**Example**

```csharp
var stream = CPH.YouTubeGetLatestBroadcast();
if (stream != null) CPH.LogInfo(stream.Url);
```

## YouTubeGetMonitoredBroadcasts

Lists every YouTube broadcast (live stream) Cuebot is watching right now.

```csharp
List<YouTubeBroadcastInfo> YouTubeGetMonitoredBroadcasts()
```

**Gives back:** A list of broadcasts, or an empty list when there are none.

**Example**

```csharp
var streams = CPH.YouTubeGetMonitoredBroadcasts();
CPH.LogInfo($"Watching {streams.Count} YouTube broadcast(s)");
```

## KickGetBroadcaster

Gets your own Kick account (the broadcaster you signed in with): its name, login, id and channel name in the web link (slug).

```csharp
KickUserInfo? KickGetBroadcaster()
```

**Gives back:** Your account details, or null (nothing) when Kick is not signed in.

**Example**

```csharp
var me = CPH.KickGetBroadcaster();
if (me != null) CPH.LogInfo($"Kick channel: {me.ChannelSlug}");
```

## KickGetBot

Gets your Kick bot account: its name and id.

```csharp
KickUserInfo? KickGetBot()
```

**Gives back:** The bot account details, or null (nothing) when no bot account is signed in.

**Example**

```csharp
var bot = CPH.KickGetBot();
if (bot != null) CPH.LogInfo($"Kick bot: {bot.UserName}");
```
